The result: less time managing the process and more time with customers. https://chatgpt.com/work

items.title: Don’t be data poor — Anuj Iravane, Anterior

Anuj Iravane calls it an observation through a fuzzy lens over a lifespan. items.title: Healthcare’s Agent Bytecode: X12 as the Harness for AI Agents — Vasant Kearney, Onlay
items.content_snippet: Call the payer, open their web portal, and read their X12 feed, and all three can tell you the patient is covered. items.title: Shipping AI to a Million Patients Without an A/B Test — Jared Joselowitz, Ufonia
items.content_snippet: You cannot A/B test on patients, because randomizing someone into the worse variant is unethical and often illegal. You cannot undo a call once spoken. And a vendor's benchmark number is not a defense at a post incident review. items.title: Guardrails First: Engineering Member-Facing Health AI — Rashi Agrawal, Hinge Health
items.content_snippet: A healthy 60 year old man asked a popular AI assistant how to cut salt from his diet. It pointed him at sodium bromide.
